rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Great rainbow serpent rising from beneath earth to drink from clouds.

visual_requirements.description: One enormous limbless serpent; red and blue scale coloration reflects dual nature.
Rises into clouds to drink water; rain physically falls around its coils.
Earth below and wet clouds above, connecting earth and sky.

aura: Keagungan dari ular besar naik minum awan dan hujan fisik (oshunmare-c05, oshunmare-c06, oshunmare-c13), tanpa aura generik.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of OSHUNMARE, the Yoruba rainbow Orisha as the Great Snake of the Underneath.
ANATOMY: exactly ONE head and ONE enormous limbless snake body, no wings, no horns, red and deep blue wet scales [oshunmare-c05,c09].
MOMENT: rising vertically from beneath the dark earth, its gigantic head reaching into rain clouds and opening its mouth to drink their water; immense curves fill the square.
POWER: heavy rain pours physically from the clouds along its body; water enters the mouth, the documented rain deity bridging earth and sky [oshunmare-c05,c06,c13].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle beneath a massive serpentine neck, tiny distant trees establish enormous documented serpent scale, head and upper coil dominate frame.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one golden break in the storm clouds outlines the wet head; deep shadow, sheets of rain and spray, restrained natural rainbow refraction in rain far behind.
SURFACE: dark red and blue tactile wet scales, water beads.
SETTING: emerging from the earth to water-bearing clouds [oshunmare-c09,c13].
MOOD: overwhelming sacred majesty, respectful living Yoruba religion, awe-inspiring and active.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs; no film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
